description: This Java abstract class 'CollectionPart' serves as a wrapper for a partial collection, storing additional metadata such as the first element index, maximum elements, total elements count, and whether the total count is exact. It provides constructors for initialization, accessor methods, and an abstract method to retrieve the underlying collection.

classes.name: CollectionPart
classes.description: An abstract class representing a partial collection with metadata including bounds and total size.

methods.name: CollectionPart
methods.description: Constructor initializing collection metadata with validation.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return the collection.

methods.name: getFirstElement
methods.description: Returns the index of the first element in the collection part.

methods.name: getMaxElements
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements that can be included.

methods.name: getTotalElements
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the underlying collection.

methods.name: isTotalElementsExact
methods.description: Indicates if the total number of elements is an exact count.
